MESSAGE: Oh, don’t worry at all, I’ll tell you!
We believe that when a wolf dies, his or her spirit travels to the moon and rests for awhile.
We howl at the moon to call the spirits back to be reborn as Moon Pack wolves, rather than any other type of wolf.
When a wolf in our pack dies, we stay with the body for three days and three nights, to keep their spirit safe on its journey.
Once a spirit is reborn, he or she has no memory of their previous life.
However, they say that if a wolf was close to that wolf in their past life, they might feel a connection to each other.
